1. Exemption is allowed subject to all just exceptions.

1. This petition has been filed for quashing of the FIR No.512/2018 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at PS Sagarpur, New Delhi, on the ground of a settlement between the parties dated 06.04.2022, which is on record of this Court.
The said settlement was arrived at with the facilitation of the Family Court, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi.

entities.text: Family Court, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The petitioner Nos.1 - 3 and respondent No.2/complainant are present in Court, duly identified by the counsels and the IO.
The petitioner Nos.2, 3 & 4 are exempted from appearance on the oral request of the learned counsel for the petitioners since they are indisposed.

As per the settlement, a final balance amount of Rs. 2 Lakhs is being tendered vide a DD bearing No.000344 dated 06.03.2023 for Rs.2,00,000/- drawn on HDFC Bank, to respondent No.2, who has duly received the same in Court and acknowledges it.
3. The petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 were married on 09.05.2016 and no child was born out of the wedlock.
The marriage is now dissolved vide a decree dated 09.01.2023.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR Nitin Sharma & Ors vs State (Nct Of Delhi) & Anr on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106371741/
